en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a town square with a fenced garden and a large pedestal supporting a bust monument of Kaiser Wilhelm. Behind the monument are ivy-covered church walls on the left and a row of traditional multi‑story buildings with shop signs on the right. The title text at the top reads that this is the church square with the Kaiser Wilhelm monument in Großenhain.
